mapper.sql: select v.venue_id, v.activity_id, v.venue_name, v.is_live, v.cover_url, v.live_start, v.live_end, v.live_status, v.sort_order, v.del_flag, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time, v.remark, (select count(1) from yc_topic t where t.venue_id=v.venue_id and t.del_flag='0') as topic_count, (select count(1) from yc_schedule s join yc_topic t2 on t2.topic_id=s.topic_id and t2.del_flag='0' where t2.venue_id=v.venue_id and s.del_flag='0') as schedule_count from yc_venue v
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when is_live='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as liveCount, ifnull(sum(case when is_live='0' then 1 else 0 end),0) as normalCount from yc_venue where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_venue set del_flag='2' where venue_id in #{id}
